unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1722 (open, by dhyabi2, verified) on daydreamsai/lucid-agents: Add a Nano (XNO) payment adapter beside x402 commerce and MPP. Cited their own payments table (x402 EVM/Solana, MPP Tempo/Stripe) and their declared design that wallets/payment protocols/networks/facilitators stay external and pluggable; positioned XNO as one more payments-slot entry. Settlement is one feeless ~0.2s Nano send block with absolute finality, no gas token, nothing to relay, receipt = block hash; existing policy/idempotency/accounting layers apply unchanged. No AI banner; offered to draft the adapter agains
